def transform(grid):
    """Apply the 3-cycle mirroring transformation"""
    H_in, W_in = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    H_out = 3 * H_in
    input_indices = list(range(H_in-1, -1, -1)) + list(range(H_in)) + list(range(H_in-1, -1, -1))

        rev_row = [grid[k][W_in-1-j] for j in range(W_in)]
        orig_row = grid[k]
